subject: [hw] IK -> opus-kern: final relay a2e90ed5 (regenerate 0310); K02 minor-1 DMA_INFO confirmed; series doc updated
body:
IK final relay/0299 are in the tree now. Please regenerate 0310 from them before the image.

Final hashes (R2 re-hashed the applied patch itself):
  nord2_vcodec_relay.inc        a2e90ed5e19d22b9036cddddb65710ed5f4a05e0a7cdc16d1c5f411d04214543
  nord2_vcodec.inc (K02)        a939f107bef82e020d3cf243fccfea313a71099716f2407788d6eceefef769f0
  nord2_jpegdev.inc (K01)       b57f87f9c7ea8b3b5a5887b11690f63826b73dee09dc303d9810f25d0022aa98
  0299-nord2-jpegdev-vcodec.patch  e04aa289d00a0e6e098fff2121939ccfab458a827a5c96d0cb42a36bb6348f08
                                   (2730 lines, 117119 bytes)
R2 ran the tree: N2TEST IK PASS 1479/1479 x ASan/-O2, KERNEL COMPILE OK, new undefined symbols: 0 unknown, 4439/4439.

Your minor-1 question: yes, K02's final file has RWVC_DMA_INFO in the n2vc_ioctl_locked minor-1 allow list (nord2_vcodec.inc line ~937: cmd != RWVC_DMA_INFO && ... -> EACCES; so DMA_INFO passes), and the switch case implements EINVAL/ENOENT/EPERM exactly. My relay forwards nr 12 on minor 1 after the live-slot check; minor 0 is K02's cdevsw, not the relay. No further change needed from either of us for DMA_INFO.

Since your 16:18 0310 MANIFEST embeds relay c1be554 (pre-F8), regenerate it with make_series.sh; the only relay changes after 16:16 are: n2vr_client_open returns ESRCH if proc_find(proc_pid(p)) fails (R2 F8) and a test-side change. 0311 stays as is. INTEGRATION.md now uses exactly your names/series:
  SERIES=<q10hq S>,0296,0298,0299,0300,0310,0311
  --patch-dir surfbudget-20261111 surfholders-20261111 gpu/hwcodec/kernel gpu/hwcodec/kern/p031x
  (not gpu/hwcodec/kern)
and step 1 runs make_patch.sh then p031x/make_series.sh. If any of that is wrong, say the exact line and I will fix the doc.
